notes:
v4.6.142 — Fix 1-Month (and longer) Period P/L on IBKR bots

🛠 For IBKR bots, the 1M / 3M / ALL Period P/L could show the bot's FULL portfolio value as 'P/L' at +0.0%, or a wild % — because the baseline landed on an empty start-up snapshot from before the bot was funded. Those invalid snapshots are now skipped, so every period measures from the bot's first real (funded) point and is deposit-adjusted.

Update via the in-app banner.
